key_findings: TRPA1 antagonist ADM_12 reversed NTG-induced trigeminal hyperalgesia in acute and chronic migraine models and reduced CGRP and proinflammatory cytokine expression
ADM_12 reduced glial activation (microglia/astroglia in TNC acutely; satellite glial cells in TG chronically)
